title: Audited financial statements
definition: The audited accounts of a company for the relevant financial years, with the auditor's opinion. They are requested where the transaction volume being assessed has to be placed against the entity's declared turnover, and they establish a figure that has been independently examined rather than a figure the customer asserted.
evidence_to_cite: the audited accounts, the financial years they cover and the audit opinion
the turnover figure, and the note in which it is disclosed
the auditor's identity and the date of the opinion

sources.citation: Financial information supporting customer due diligence and risk assessment, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
